P001 ST02 wellbore has been abandoned preparation for slot recovery. 9-5/8" casing was cut 95'BML, 13-3/8", 18-5/8" and 30" were cut at 80' BML and all strings have been removed.

Note: P001 will be renamed to P003 at time of slot recovery.

Due to the fact that this well was classified as P&A?d by a previous operator in 1972 when the well was actually TA?d, McMoRan cannot change the P&A date to truly reflect the correct P&A date.  The A002 well was actually P&A?d (all casings removed 16-ft BML) on 09/25/2010.

The 20" and 30" casing strings were cut at 15'BML.  In the process of recovering the casing, they became stuck in the damaged platform trying to pull to the surface.  Conductors will be pulled when platform is removed.

10/24/05 - Approval given to reperforate tubing higher @ 5175'for a plug from 4875'- 5175' in the SS and annulus.  SS was perforated 2x @ 6000' for a balanced plug from 5700' - 6000'.  Could barely circulate 1/2 bbl per minute @ 3000 psi.  

10/28/05 - Both tubing strings have leak near safety valve.  Approval to perforate both strings above obstruction in LS & circulate 300' balanced plug in both tubings & annulus, cut tubings @ 1000' and set casing x casing plug.

11/23/05 - Approval to set CIBP in 7-5/8" casing @ 590' for a 290' cement plug on top & not remove any of the production casing at this time.

The subject well was drilled to 11,150' MD / 10,696' TVD. A 7", 26.0 ppf,HCP-110, Ultra SF production liner was ran and cemented from 7,910' - 11,150'. Top of cement is at the liner top based on cement being reverse out after the liner cement job and CBL. Plugged cased-hole MDT 3/16" hole exist in the Bul 1-6 Sand at 10,995' and an unplugged 3/16" hole exist at 10,975'.

Completed as a single oil well with a FP completion in the Bul 1-6 Sand from 10,950' - 11,006' in 7' casing.

The MU 736 #1BP2 was spud on 10-13-07 and TD on 10-20-07 at depth of 11190' MD / 11180' TVD, MW 14.5 ppg.  A 5" 18#/ft, P-110 prod. liner was set from 9392'- 11172' MD.

The Marg A 4B Sand was perforated from 11025'- 11042' & 11080' - 11110' and a drill stem test of the sand was attempted. The perforations did not flow. The Marg A 4b sand perfs were abandoned.

The Marg A 4a Sand was perforated from 10032' - 10072' & 10105' - 10130' MD. A drill stem test of the Marg A 4a Sd was attemtped and the completion flowed only water.

Subsequently the MU 736 #1BP2 was plugged and abandoned on 11-26-07.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the EW 306 A01ST well to produce the "Upper JE" Sand Completion.  The previous producing interval, the "JE" Sand was isolated by closing the sliding sleeve @ 10699' & setting 2 MRBP @ 10669'  & 10665' MD.

The "Upper JE" Sand exisiting perforations of 10666' - 10674' MD were then exposed to production by opening the sliding at 10662' MD.

Operations began on 03-21-09 & were completed on 05-28-09.

The well was temporarily abandoned through the surface plug as of 05/05/2025; however, eWell recognizes the zonal isolation date as the temporary abandonment date from a previous EOR and cannot be changed.

SS 224 E19BP2 was spud on June 27, 2008 and drilled to TD on July 5, 2008 to a depth of 12056 MD/10253TVD.  The well was completed for production as a single, gravel packed oil completion in the "ED Sand", with perforations of 11,518'-11530'MD and an alternate completion in the "EF Sand", with perforations of 11,728'-11812" MD. Completion Operations were completed on 07/25/2008

36" csg cut @ 20' BML on 4/7/2011.  16" csg cut @ 20' BML on 4/6/2011.  36" x 16" csg not pulled at this time, will be pulled at time of platform removal.  10-3/4" csg cut & pulled @ 25' BML on 4/6/2011.  All csg cut via mechanical means.

Coiled tubing operations were successfully completed on the VK 990 Well A-28ST to clean out the wellbore and isolate the "M83C" Sand existing perfortions of 15,992'-16,072' MD due to lower GP screen failure. The "M83C" Sand perforations were isolated by setting a NVTTBP at 15,727' MD and dumping 17' of cmt on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 15,710' MD. Operations started 11-16-2012 and ended 12-18-2012.

The purpose of this EOR is for reporting that the Recompletion of the CM Sand was unsuccessful due to after successfully setting a petal basket in the tubing @ 5960' MD & dumping 2' of sand on top, then while attempting to dump cmt on top of the sand it was discovered that the cement had been strung out in the tubing during the initial TTVBP setting operation at 3,355' MD.  Nothing on this EOR has changed except for the attached new Current WB Schematic showing the above described operations on the new Current WB Schematic.

Stone has utilized the MODU: Hercules 201 to drill and temporarily abandon the SS 118, OCS-00068, Well B001ST00BP00.  The SS 118, B001 well was spud on June 29, 2012.  The well was drilled to a TD of 9307' MD / 9153' TVD @ 0400 hrs on July 27, 2012.  No hydrocarbons were logged in the open hole.  The SS 118, B001 wellbore was TA'd on 1800 hrs on July 29, 2012.

ERT has successfully performed the initial completion operations of the EC 346 A12ST4 well.  Drilling operations began on 08-26-09, with the well TD'd at 9564' MD / 9439' TVD, w/a MW of 14.6 ppg SBM on 
09-12-09.  

The well was completed for production on 10-07-09.  The well was completed as a single, gravel packed, oil completion in the "Lentic 1-3" Sand with perforations of 9440' - 9494' MD.

Attempt to melt hydrate and conduct fishing operations.
Anadarko was successful in removing the hydrate blockage, and much of the slickline that was left in the A004. However, during the fishing operations with braided line, we got hung up and had to cut the braided line with a mechanical cutter. We were unsuccessful at retrieving this mechanical cutter and the braided line toolstring.  However, the current fish sits below the current perfs (C-Mac) and below the SCSSV.
We were able to return the C-Mac to production with gaslift from 8/15/12 to 8/23/12. However, the watercut was at 100% and it was decided to shut-in the well for the time being.

Correction report has been filed to change "Well Status". 

Please note that McMoRan did not pump any cement or set any CIBPs in this well.  McMoRan only performed milling operations. 

This well was previously classified as PA'd by a previous operator in 2000.  McMoRan only performed milling operations on this well.

Permanently isolated D-10 Sand, and added perfs to D-2 Sand.  The long string tubing was perforated at the same time the casing was perforated, and the D-2 sand is now flowing up the long string (short string tubing remains out of service due to mechanical problems).

WELL HAS BEEN RECOMPLETED (CHZ). Well remains shut in, and will not have first production for some time, due to damages from hurricanes Gustav and Ike. Please note that the perforations were reshot due to spacing on 07/29/2008 (originally shot on 07/27/2008).

Stone has successfully plugged back and prepared for sidetrack operations the MC 109 A06 well using the H&P 206 platform rig unit.

The current completion interval for the well, the ""J" Sand perforations, 9438' - 9532' MD  was isolated by setting a cement retainer @ 9300 and squeezing the perfs with cement, leaving ETOC in the 7" csg @ 9300'.  A 300' cement plug in the 7" csg was set from 9300' - 9000' MD.  

The 7" prod. csg was cut & pulled at 2500' MD.   A cmt retainer was set in the 7" csg @ 2450' MD & 225 sxs of cmt sqz'd below the retainer.  50' of cmt was dumped on top of the retainer @ 2450', ETOC @ 2400'.  The 9 5/8" csg was perforated, 2030' - 2033' MD.   A EZSV set at 2000' and 300 sxs of cmt squeezed below the retainer.

Operations began on 07-20-11 and were completed on 08-16-11.

The SS 93 E1 was spud on 12-09-10 and drilled to a TD of 11588' MD / 10925' TVD, w/a MW of 10.8 ppg on 12-25-10.    The wellbore collapsed @ 5850' MD / 5568' TVD and the well was plugged back for by-pass operations by setting a 851' cmt plug from 5851' - 5000' MD.  Operations were completed on the well on 12-30-10, when the wellbore was bypassed @ 5512' MD.
